title: Checking In for a Flight
objective: Check in for a flight, answer baggage questions, choose a seat, and find the gate
situation: You are at the airline desk checking in for an international flight.
closing_display_text: No, that is everything. Have a pleasant flight!
closing_spoken_text: No, that is everything. Have a pleasant flight!

turns.assistant_display_text: Good morning. May I see your passport and ticket?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Good morning. May I see your passport and ticket?
turns.user_display_text: Of course. Here are my passport and ticket.
turns.user_expected_text: Of course. Here are my passport and ticket.

turns.assistant_display_text: Are you checking in any bags today?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Are you checking in any bags today?
turns.user_display_text: Yes, I have one suitcase to check in.
turns.user_expected_text: Yes, I have one suitcase to check in.
turns.arabic_hint: قل إن لديك حقيبة واحدة للشحن.

turns.assistant_display_text: Did you pack the suitcase yourself?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Did you pack the suitcase yourself?
turns.user_display_text: Yes, I packed it myself this morning.
turns.user_expected_text: Yes, I packed it myself this morning.
turns.arabic_hint: أكّد أنك حزمت الحقيبة بنفسك هذا الصباح.

turns.assistant_display_text: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
turns.user_display_text: I would prefer a window seat, please.
turns.user_expected_text: I would prefer a window seat, please.

turns.assistant_display_text: Your gate is A twelve. Boarding starts at nine thirty.
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Your gate is A twelve. Boarding starts at nine thirty.
turns.user_display_text: Thank you. How long will it take to reach the gate?
turns.user_expected_text: Thank you. How long will it take to reach the gate?
turns.arabic_hint: اسأل عن الوقت اللازم للوصول إلى البوابة.

turns.assistant_display_text: About ten minutes. Security is just ahead.
turns.assistant_spoken_text: About ten minutes. Security is just ahead.
turns.user_display_text: Great. Is there anything else I need to do?
turns.user_expected_text: Great. Is there anything else I need to do?
turns.arabic_hint: اسأل إذا كان عليك فعل أي شيء آخر.
